title: Prepare your service desk and open the customer list
goal: Prepare a separate small practice application without BSL or changing the preceding infobase.

prerequisites.text: Create an empty infobase and distinguish Designer from Enterprise mode.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: Yesterday an empty infobase had no Customers command. Nothing was broken: the platform did not yet have the service definition. Today we prepare a separate practice app. The key question is which directory the load will change. Preserve the introductory infobase; the new one receives commands, not ready-made customers.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Use installed 1C:Enterprise. Designer is needed only to prepare the new empty target; enter cards and requests in the application. Nexus provides explanation, example, reference and your note; it neither transfers records into 1C nor observes unsaved fields. These manual tasks need no BSL or Code Studio.

sections.title: Why a prepared configuration is useful
paragraphs: The introductory empty infobase helped identify windows but has no application lists yet. Customer entry requires a catalog definition. Our small original Training service desk supplies Customers, Services and Service request. It includes no real data or third-party application. Writing BSL is unnecessary for the first customer card.

A configuration is not the platform. First install the official training platform from its source; separately download the training-service CF (full filename beside the example) using the lab-guide button. Do not run this file as an installer: load it through Designer into your own infobase.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Only a verified empty target is used.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: A new location for the new practice
paragraphs: Create another startup entry without a configuration, name it Training service desk — practice and choose a new separate directory. Do not load into the introductory infobase. Before launch distinguish similar entries by their registered directories; different copies can display the same configuration title.

The .cf contains structure, not every customer from another infobase. Loading it changes the selected application definition. Establish that the target is new and empty first; otherwise cancel and return to the startup list.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Loading a CF adds the Customers list, but it has no rows. Must you restore somebody else’s DT?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A CF defines the service structure; an empty list is expected in a new infobase. Check your own directory, applied configuration and cleared search. Then create your own training records. Other people’s data is unnecessary.

sections.title: Load, apply and open
paragraphs: Open Designer from the verified new entry. Select Configuration → Load configuration from file and choose the .cf. Then Update database configuration (usually F7), read the changes and wait. Start Enterprise mode after completion.

Find the Учебная сервисная служба section and Клиенты command; placement can vary with version. Opening the list creates no customer. It is empty in a new infobase. The next lesson creates the first card and verifies it survives reopening.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Cancel loading into an unidentified or already-used infobase before changing it; choose a new empty one.
Load it using Designer; install the platform separately.

sections.title: Continue instead of starting over
paragraphs: Each day open the same practice entry. Reloading .cf is not normal continuation and can affect structural edits. Use .dt for data backup and a separate restoration check. Keep a short note identifying your infobase, lesson and next action.

Nexus knows the selected lesson and saved local position, but does not automatically inspect external 1C. For an empty list check the entry, directory and search first. The engineering stand with seeded test records is a separate experiment; its numbers and totals do not replace observations of your new infobase.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Prepare another own empty infobase named “Service — my experiment” in a new directory. Use the training-service CF from the adjacent guide. Record the introductory and target directories before loading; after loading and updating, open Customers. Create no records yet. Establish the intended target, empty list and preservation of the introductory infobase.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author checked actual CF loading into a new own infobase, saving and renaming customers, 30/45 requests, refusal without Customer and a separate new 20/55 experiment. All four records were compared after restarting; the worked pair is preserved. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Learner actions, installer, permissions, training build 1508 and complete manual entry of every form are not verified.
